title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   C. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   D. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   C. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. A — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Iman; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Love; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic etiquettes:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
